_readme: Tell Desk, as the site shows it. LEAD: set address and deployTx after deploying desk/ to Preprod; set fieldsConfirmed to true once publicLedger, privateState and circuits match desk/contract; implement readDesk() in web/lib/desk.ts.

publicLedger.name: grades
publicLedger.holds: The privacy grade (A to F) filed for each scanned contract, keyed by its address

publicLedger.name: reports
publicLedger.holds: A salted commitment to the full sealed report. It proves which report the grade came from without revealing it

publicLedger.name: scanner
publicLedger.holds: A hash of the Tell engine version and rules used, so anyone can reproduce a grade

publicLedger.name: filers
publicLedger.holds: A one-way tag of each filer's key: who may update a grade, without naming them
publicLedger.who: Anyone; not linkable to a wallet

publicLedger.name: round
publicLedger.holds: How many grades have been filed, so a reader can tell whether the registry is up to date

privateState.name: report
privateState.holds: Every finding, line and fix: what the grade is based on
privateState.who: The team, and whoever they share it with

privateState.name: salt
privateState.holds: The random salt behind the report commitment. Sharing it lets an auditor open the seal

privateState.name: filerKey
privateState.holds: The secret key behind the filer tag. It proves the right to update a grade

privateState.name: source
privateState.holds: The contract that was scanned, if it is not public

circuits.name: file
circuits.does: Files a grade and a sealed report commitment for a contract address
circuits.discloses: The grade, the commitment and the filer tag; never the report

circuits.name: open
circuits.does: Proves a shared report matches the commitment on chain, for an auditor
circuits.discloses: Nothing new: the check runs inside the proof

circuits.name: regrade
circuits.does: Replaces a grade after a fix, filed by the same filer

flow.text: Tell scans the contract and produces the report and a grade.
Your wallet commits to the report with a fresh salt. The report and the salt stay in your private state.
One transaction puts the grade and the commitment on the public ledger, keyed by the contract's address.
Before you sign, a wallet or dApp store looks up the grade by address.
Share the report and the salt with an auditor. They check it against the commitment, and no one else learns anything.
